lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I have brought provisions from Bethlehem for my brothers.

lines.speaker: Baggage keeper
lines.text: Leave them here, young shepherd. I will keep them safe.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Thank you. Where can I find my brothers?

lines.speaker: Baggage keeper
lines.text: By the line beyond the tents. Follow the path, and stay clear of the ranks.

lines.speaker: Eliab
lines.text: David? Who is tending the sheep at home?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: They are in safe hands. Our father sent food, and asked me to see how you are.

lines.speaker: Eliab
lines.text: We are well. Stay close. The camp is waiting for the champion's next challenge.
